name: Sausage, Mash & Onion Gravy
method: Boil the potatoes until soft, then mash with the milk and butter.
Grill the sausages for 17–20 minutes, turning, until cooked through. Meanwhile soften the sliced onion in a pan, stir in the cornflour and 300 ml hot water and bubble into a gravy.
Boil the peas and carrots and serve everything together.
